The Auction House is one of the most used features on the SMP SMP, allowing players to buy and sell items. Buying/Selling things on the Auction House is one of the ways players make lots of money on the Donut SMP.

== Mechanics ==

* Players can purchase items they need by typing /auction or /ah in chat.
* Players can sell items they don't want for money. Click the chest in the Auction House at the bottom and click the empty map to choose what to sell. Then, put the item in and click the green glass to continue. Finally, enter the amount of money that you want to sell it and click done in the sign that shows up while you click the green glass and then check if there's no error then, click the green glass to sell it.
* Players can click the hopper at the bottom of the Auction House to filter the type of item that you want to buy.
* Players can click the sign at the bottom of the Auction House to search for item that you want to buy.
* Players can click the anvil to reload the Auction House.
* Players can click the cauldron at the bottom to filter item with Highest Price/ Lowest Price / Recently Listed
* Players can click the arrow at the bottom left and right to go to the next page of the Auction House
* With Donut memberships, you get extra perks. (45 slots for donut+, 90 slots for donut++ and donut+++)
